long_description: Cedar is a patient self-pay platform that replaces manual revenue cycle workflows with a digital-first billing experience. Founded in 2016 and backed by approximately $425M (peak valuation ~$3.2B), Cedar works with more than 35 provider organizations and has processed over $10 billion in patient payments since 2017. Cedar Pay helps healthcare providers increase revenue with empathetic patient billing, claiming a 22% collections lift and 89% patient satisfaction. The platform streamlines paper-heavy RCM workflows with self-service payment plans, autopay, and plain-language digital statements. In April 2026, Cedar expanded Cedar Intelligence with AI capabilities for personalized outreach timing, channel, tone, and resolution options, plus an AI voice agent for difficult-to-reach patients. Cedar Cover (launched October 2025) screens patients for coverage and routes them through Medicaid enrollment, renewals, and medication assistance. Cedar uses Stripe's Optimized Checkout Suite for payments.

faqs.a: Cedar is a patient financial engagement platform that modernizes healthcare payments for hospitals and health systems. It provides digital billing, self-service payment plans, and AI-powered personalization to increase collections while improving patient satisfaction.

faqs.q: How does Cedar differ from Waystar?
faqs.a: Cedar focuses on post-visit patient experience - clarifying bills, collecting payments, and connecting patients to coverage. Waystar focuses on claims, clearinghouse, and broad revenue cycle automation. Many health systems use both.

Cedar Intelligence is Cedar's AI-powered decision engine that personalizes patient outreach timing, channel, tone, and resolution options. It includes an agent copilot for support teams and an AI voice agent for engaging difficult-to-reach patients.
Cedar reports a 22% collections lift and 89% patient satisfaction. The platform has processed over $10 billion in patient payments since 2017 across 35+ provider organizations.
